titleAr: ابعت لنفسي ايميل تجريبي من رسايل البداية
titleEn: Send a lifecycle email to myself as a test

undo.note: A test email goes only to the signed-in owner's own address; nothing to undo.

ar: ابعتلي نسخة تجريبية من ايميل الترحيب
عايز اشوف الايميل اللي بيوصل للعميل
en: Send me a test of the welcome email

steps: Press Send test to me on the row (owner only): the email arrives at your own address.
edgeCases: Owner only: a staff member gets 403 and the assistant says the store owner can send the test
Mobile: admin pages are responsive; Arabic/RTL: numbers and mixed Arabic/English text must render correctly (Arabic-Indic digits normalised on input)
Provider/outage or rate limit (writeLimiter) returns an error: assistant reports the exact failure and does not claim success
